Hi!

I would like an art of my rabbit fursona!
You can really draw him in any pose that you like. I would like him to be dressed, you can put him informal clothes to dress, like casual to be on the street. Whatever you like. I would like him like most furries without shoes.

That's all! I just want to see him on your style! Please make sure he looks happy.

Sorry if something looks weird. i'm from spain and it's translated with the bot.

-私のOCの最大の特徴は、左目の電気アイマスクです。
